scientific_integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved analytically. Deterministic quadrature is used only as a reproducibility sanity check and not as evidence for an infinite-parameter claim.
scientific_limitations: The result is local in the one-parameter two-sided exponential family. It does not determine the global minimizer, the transition exponent, or the existence of additional nonsymmetric local minima.
title: Strict local stability of the symmetric exponential under variance normalization
